panel.summary: `allowed_bots` may not be a supported input at the pinned claude-code-action commit, in which case it is silently ignored and the fix job still fails
panel.evidence: The action is pinned to the immutable commit `af0559ee4f514d1ef21826982bed13f7edc3c35e # v1` (line 404 / agent-iterate-ci.yml:151). GitHub Actions only *warns* on an input a composite/node action does not declare — it does not fail — so if `allowed_bots` was added to claude-code-action after that pinned commit, this change has no runtime effect at all and the bot-rejection failure persists unchanged. Nothing in the diff bumps the pin or verifies the input exists at that SHA.
